installCommand: echo "Using Node.js $(node -v) and pnpm $(pnpm -v)" && echo "//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=\${GH_PKG_REGISTRY_TOKEN}" >> ~/.npmrc && pnpm ci --filter "{.}..."
ignoreCommand: GPS="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; git diff $([ -n "$GPS" ] && git show "$GPS" &>/dev/null && echo "$GPS" || echo HEAD^) HEAD --quiet ../../pnpm-lock.yaml ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ../../package.json ../database ./ ../donations/core
